answer: Register each agent as one vertex in an identity graph, bound to a single non-transferable credential whose hash enters a nullifier registry anyone can audit in seconds. A credential used twice proves duplication, and it is slashed: 400 tokens locked 90 days, 100% lost on second use. A prism audit splits each funding trail across rotating reviewers, so clusters sharing one funder cannot vouch for each other; at three shared-funder identities, all three freeze. To forge 1,000 fakes, an attacker must buy and fund 1,000 credentials: 400,000 tokens locked, no bulk discount.
